fast.description: Routine local check: cheap unit files run whole, plus selected end-to-end smoke tests per feature area. Releases use the full suite.

test/autonomy-cli.e2e.mjs: task start blocks product work before preflight when approved requirement write scope is empty
test/baseline-refresh-guard.e2e.mjs: projects outside git and repositories without a commit refresh as before
test/baseline-refresh-shared.e2e.mjs: a refresh on a computer without a reachable remote writes nothing in a shared project
test/baseline-scale.e2e.mjs: baseline summaries come from the derived index until a record changes
test/budget-cost-control.e2e.mjs: the shipped default budget is soft-only, so a normal project can complete without signing keys
test/capability-inventory.e2e.mjs: capability inventory is a catalogued read-only command
test/cli-exit-codes.e2e.mjs: a blocked gate check exits 1 and the documented pipeline example treats it that way
test/cli-self-service.e2e.mjs: machine mode returns one stable JSON error envelope
test/cli.e2e.mjs: status starts the stock story workflow and routes custom phases to an exact definition
story create persists acceptance criteria with human-readable alias
contract create auto-links story contract and requires explicit replacement
strict gate fails when a story has no contract
test/delegated-approvals.e2e.mjs: story.supersede: a delegation lets the agent supersede one story; none or an expired one is refused
test/delegation-publish.e2e.mjs: an altered or missing delegation is never published
test/doctor-records.e2e.mjs: doctor suggests a readable identity for shared claims and confirms it once set
test/governance-finalization.e2e.mjs: the latest failed test or release trace overrides an older passing attempt for steps and final gate
test/identity-migration.e2e.mjs: migration identity CLI recovers only the prepared exact physical mutation set
test/merge-decision.e2e.mjs: the merge choice is the user's explicit answer and automatic needs merge authority above supervised
test/merged-certification.e2e.mjs: documentation committed after the merge and an untracked note leave the merged story completed
test/novice-requirement-journey.e2e.mjs: requirement intake is useful before a contract exists
fresh init hides bootstrap records and points to the first meaningful choice
test/operations-phase.e2e.mjs: a story in the operations phase records incidents and feedback against a real release manifest
test/plugin-compatibility.e2e.mjs: a project whose records this plugin understands runs normally and its cache follows the plugin version
test/project-archive.e2e.mjs: project archive refuses when a remote cannot be checked and when shared refs sit on a remote
test/records-publish-scope.e2e.mjs: publishing named record files refuses a path outside the records folder and pushes nothing
test/regression-governance-matrix.test.m: delivery matrix binds local, new PR, and existing PR targets without widening actions
workflow matrix preserves v1/v2 and governs v3 with phase-bound evidence
autonomy and authority matrix resolves all levels and fails closed on unverifiable authority
test/release-package-verifier.e2e.mjs: verifies a real npm pack through offline install and installed-package smoke tests
test/requirement-supersede-same-source.e: the replacement revision must still be source-fresh
test/review-gate.e2e.mjs: a new pull-request delivery needs the user's own answer on code review
test/secret-scan.e2e.mjs: an explicit commit range scans only what that range changed
test/standing-approvals.e2e.mjs: a project without git still uses its standing approvals on this computer
test/story-claims-shared.e2e.mjs: a story claimed on another computer cannot be cancelled from here until its claim ends
test/story-close.e2e.mjs: story close on a merged story runs sync, scan and release trace with one shared fetch
test/story-closure.e2e.mjs: story abandon closes a started story that delivered nothing and releases its claim
test/story-fix.e2e.mjs: a fix story records its link, inherits requirements, starts in design and shows in the Observatory
test/story-prepare.e2e.mjs: preparing with an open dependency makes the contract, the worktree from origin/main and the record, and starts nothing
test/story-split-dependencies.e2e.mjs: a dependency names the story it effectively waits on and where that story stands
test/story-sync.e2e.mjs: story sync rebases freely once the governed commit is on the remote
test/story-waits.e2e.mjs: wait conditions, leases, and claim health follow plain rules
test/template-overlay-security.e2e.mjs: custom template asset symlinks are rejected before initialization
test/test-triage.e2e.mjs: test record keeps the case and the failed-minor outcome in the record and in the trace
test/trace-rebase.e2e.mjs: trace rebase also merges the output registry by entry id
test/unit/cli-observability.test.mjs: unknown JSON help paths redact GitHub tokens from every error branch
requirement propose derives secondary criteria and keeps explicit acceptance unchanged
test/unit/governance-mutation-cli.test.m: CLI init completes through its exact bootstrap mutation profile
test/unit/initialization-guidance.test.m: an empty project is guided to init
test/unit/test-evidence-cli.test.mjs: a story still missing a passing test trace keeps failing, and disabling the policy stops the check
test/unit/trace-status-observability.tes: an uninitialized folder puts the initialize instruction in the primary next step
test/unit/workflow-cli-integrity.test.mj: start recovery preserves divergent staging bytes and fails closed
